feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one
entry.summary: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.

entry.title: Key leaders sound the alarm on AI. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback
entry.summary: Some key leaders at artificial intelligence companies call for a slowdown in AI development. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback as talks in Oman are delayed.

entry.title: Beijing hits back at Anthropic CEO's call to curb China's AI development
entry.summary: China's Foreign Ministry called the Anthropic CEO's warning about the dangers of Chinese-developed AI "fearmongering," as the Chinese and U.S. leaders prepare to meet in Washington later this month.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Industry leaders call for AI development to slow down to ensure safety, Trump to campaign for GOP candidates ahead of midterms, Iranian officials say a meeting with the Gulf States has been postponed.

entry.title: Indonesia searches for 129 people missing after ferry capsizes in the Java Sea
entry.summary: Indonesian authorities intensified on Monday a search for people missing after a ferry overturned in bad weather in the Java Sea. At least six passengers were killed and 129 people are still missing.

entry.title: Russian drone hits train near Ukraine-Poland border soon after dignitaries passed through
entry.summary: A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after senior visiting officials, including the former prime ministers of the U.K. and Sweden, passed through.

entry.title: World leaders gathered for the annual BRICS summit. Here are the takeaways
entry.summary: India hosted the an annual summit which gathered leaders from 28 countries, including the presidents of China and Iran. Though, the U.S. was notably absent.

entry.title: Can Gulf states and Iran negotiate the Strait of Hormuz without the U.S.?
entry.summary: Dania Thafer of the Gulf International Forum weighs in on previously scheduled talks between Iran and Gulf states. Shortly before this interview aired, Oman announced that the talks were postponed.

entry.title: Indonesian passenger ship overturns, sparking search for at least 129 missing
entry.summary: Indonesian rescuers said about 130 passengers and crew are missing after a ferry carrying more than 240 people sank in bad weather in the Java Sea on Sunday.

entry.title: 'People are still afraid of those three letters': Fighting the stigma of HIV
entry.summary: That's a quote from former rugby star Gareth Thomas, who is HIV positive. At the International AIDS Conference in Rio this year, he spoke out about the isolation and discrimination tied to the virus.
